item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
• Add native Picture in Picture for web video
  • Spin the reload arrow while a page loads
  • Ignore other debug apps' navigation notes
  • Leave folder disclosure on its own spring
  • Put Arc favorites on every space and fix sidebar drags
  • Soften the top address bar to plain text
  • Animate folder disclosure without rebuilding the sidebar
  • Add trackpad haptics for swipes and sidebar drops
  • Describe the v0.2.0 changes
  • Release v0.2.0
  • Round-trip space emoji and keep import sheets readable
  • Add web extension support
  • Add Chrome and Arc importers
  • Keep invalid remote sort keys from crashing
  • Add sidebar drag and drop

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Sidebar drag and drop
  • Chrome and Arc import, plus first-launch onboarding
  • Web extensions, including the Chrome Web Store and .xpi
  • iCloud sync is prepared and stays off

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
• Restore back/forward history once the web view is on screen
  • Add app icon with light/dark option
  • Render each snapshot layer once
  • Add tinted toolbar, clean URL display and copy link
  • Add address bar position setting and fix collapsed sidebar
  • Honor MYBROWSER_APPEARANCE and even out space icons
  • Move toolbar above content and fix sidebar selection
  • Add two-finger swipe to switch spaces
  • Add Sparkle updates and release script
  • Toolbar above content, sidebar swipe for spaces, v0.1 release; screenshot rule
  • Fix navigation menus, sort keys, popups, and snapshots
  • Agent guide: cleanup rule
  • Fix tab load state, delete, and shifted shortcuts
  • Add command bar and keyboard shortcuts
  • Add window shell and sidebar
